# Pre-Marathon Nutrition Plan

Given that your marathon is **tomorrow morning at 7 AM**, here's your strategic eating plan:

## TODAY (Race Eve)

### Breakfast (Morning)
- White rice or plain bagel with honey
- Scrambled eggs or egg whites
- Banana
- Orange juice

### Lunch (Midday)
- White pasta or white rice with olive oil
- Grilled chicken or baked fish
- Well-cooked carrots or peeled zucchini
- White bread

### Dinner (Early - by 6 PM)
- **Keep it simple and familiar**
- More white pasta with marinara sauce (no chunks)
- Plain chicken breast
- Small portion of white potatoes
- Avoid: vegetables, spices, heavy sauces

### Throughout Day
- Sip water consistently
- Avoid alcohol and caffeine after noon
- Stop eating by 7-8 PM

## TOMORROW (Race Day)

### Pre-Race Meal (3-4 hours before - 3-4 AM)
- White bagel or toast with honey/jam
- 1-2 bananas
- Small portion of oatmeal made with water
- Sports drink or diluted juice

### 30-60 Minutes Before Start
- Energy gel or 1 banana
- Few sips of sports drink

## Key Points
- **Carb-load** today with 60-70% of calories from easily digestible carbs
- **Avoid fiber, dairy, fatty foods** to prevent GI distress
- **Stay hydrated** but don't overdo it
- **Nothing new** - stick to foods you've tested in training

Good luck with your marathon! 🏃‍♂️

# Nutrition Plan for Competitive Swimming Performance

## Daily Targets
- **Calories**: 3,000-3,500 (high energy demands from swimming)
- **Protein**: 150-170g (2.0-2.2g/kg for muscle maintenance)
- **Carbs**: 400-500g (5-6g/kg for training fuel)
- **Fats**: 80-100g (healthy fats for hormone health)

## What to Eat

### Pre-Training (1-2 hours before)
- Oatmeal with banana and almond butter
- Rice cakes with avocado and eggs
- Sweet potato with chicken and vegetables

### Post-Training (within 30-60 min)
- Salmon with quinoa and roasted vegetables
- Chicken stir-fry with rice and mixed veggies
- Tuna poke bowl with brown rice and edamame

### Daily Protein Sources (dairy-free)
- Fish (salmon, tuna, cod) - 4-6oz per meal
- Chicken, turkey - lean options
- Eggs - 3-4 daily
- Legumes (lentils, chickpeas, black beans)
- Tofu, tempeh

### Carbohydrate Sources
- Oats, quinoa, brown rice
- Sweet potatoes, regular potatoes
- Whole grain bread/pasta
- Fruits (bananas, berries, dates)

### Healthy Fats
- Avocados
- Nuts (almonds, walnuts, cashews)
- Nut butters
- Olive oil, coconut oil
- Fatty fish (omega-3s)

### Hydration & Recovery
- Water: 3-4L daily, more on heavy training days
- Coconut water (natural electrolytes)
- Tart cherry juice (anti-inflammatory)

## Sample Day

**Breakfast**: Scrambled eggs (3), oatmeal with berries and walnuts, banana

**Snack**: Apple with almond butter

**Lunch**: Grilled chicken, quinoa bowl, mixed vegetables, olive oil dressing

**Pre-workout**: Rice cakes with almond butter and honey

**Post-workout**: Salmon, sweet potato, steamed broccoli

**Dinner**: Turkey breast, brown rice, stir-fried vegetables

**Evening**: Handful of nuts, fruit

This approach prioritizes whole foods, supports your training demands, and helps improve body composition without dairy.

# Cutting Phase Nutrition Plan for Powerlifter

## Daily Macro Targets (2000 calories)
- **Protein**: 180-200g (720-800 cal) - 40%
- **Carbs**: 180-200g (720-800 cal) - 40% 
- **Fat**: 45-50g (405-450 cal) - 20%

## Sample Daily Meal Plan

### Meal 1 - Breakfast (500 cal)
- 4 whole eggs scrambled (280 cal, 24g P)
- 80g oats with water (300 cal, 10g P, 54g C)
- 1 banana (105 cal, 27g C)
- Black coffee

### Meal 2 - Pre-Training (450 cal)
- 150g chicken breast (248 cal, 47g P)
- 200g sweet potato (172 cal, 40g C)
- 100g broccoli (30 cal)

### Meal 3 - Post-Training (550 cal)
- 180g lean beef (90/10) (340 cal, 45g P)
- 150g white rice (195 cal, 42g C)
- Mixed vegetables (15 cal)

### Meal 4 - Dinner (500 cal)
- 150g salmon (310 cal, 39g P, 14g F)
- 150g quinoa (185 cal, 24g C, 6g P)
- Green salad with lemon

## Key Foods to Stock

**Protein Sources:**
- Chicken breast, lean beef, fish (salmon, tuna, cod)
- Eggs
- Protein powder (dairy-free: pea, rice, hemp blend)

**Carb Sources:**
- Rice (white/brown), oats, quinoa
- Sweet potatoes, regular potatoes
- Fruits (bananas, berries)

**Fat Sources:**
- Avocado, olive oil
- Nuts/nut butters (measured)
- Fatty fish

**Vegetables (unlimited):**
- Broccoli, spinach, peppers, asparagus, green beans

## Timing Tips
- Carbs around training (pre/post)
- Protein spread across 4 meals (~45g each)
- Track everything in MyFitnessPal or Cronometer

Would you like meal prep strategies or specific adjustments?
